title: Cookies & Christmas with Mrs. Claus
seo_title: Cookies & Christmas with Mrs. Claus in Lebanon, MO
description: Cookies & Christmas with Mrs. Claus is a kids' holiday event at The Farme where children enjoy storytime with Mr. Willowby's Christmas Tree, decorate Christmas cookies with Mrs. Claus, and have special picture opportunities. It takes place on December 12, 2026, from 9:30 to 11:30 AM at 14402 Highway 64 in Lebanon, Missouri.
